title: East Asian Calendar & Solar Terms Open Data (2020-2035)
description: Deterministic JSON and CSV reference datasets for 24 solar terms (2020-2035, VSOP87D exact minutes in UTC, JST, UTC+8), lunar new moons (2020-2035), cross-timezone Lunar New Year dates (China UTC+8, Vietnam UTC+7, Korea UTC+9), Japanese almanac indicators (2025-2030), Korean Son-eomneun-nal dates (2025-2030), and Javanese Pasaran/Weton cycles (2025-2030).
